sections.Profile:
Skyrocket , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in May 1971, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Harry Williams with artwork by Christian Marche. Featuring a circus and carnival theme, this two-player machine includes standout features such as two flippers, three pop bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
